Issue_Description: DEM terrain matching spatial resolution and update frequency are not quantified in source documents.
Potential_Impact: Cannot determine offline flash memory allocation or Kalman filter innovation bounds.
Recommended_Clarification: Specify DEM spatial resolution (e.g. 5m vs 30m grid) and coordinate projection standard.

Issue_Description: Optical zoom ratio, LWIR microbolometer pixel resolution, and thermal NETD sensitivity are omitted.
Potential_Impact: Inability to calculate optical ground sampling distance (GSD) and target recognition ranges.
Recommended_Clarification: Publish detailed optical CMOS and LWIR bolometer technical datasheet specifications.

Issue_Description: Specific COTS interim System-on-Module model (prior to sovereign VEGA/SHAKTI silicon migration) is unstated.
Potential_Impact: Prevents finalization of carrier board layout, thermal cooling dissipation, and power harness in Milestone 2.
Recommended_Clarification: Specify interim COTS compute hardware part number and carrier board form factor.

Issue_Description: Temporal visual change detection lacks quantitative detection threshold, minimum target size, and false positive limits.
Potential_Impact: Subjective verification results; inability to evaluate CNN algorithm accuracy objectively.
Recommended_Clarification: Define minimum detectable change area (e.g. 1m² at 300m AGL) and target false alarm rate.

Potential_Impact: Cannot establish pass/fail verification criteria for neural upscaling weights.

Issue_Description: Wideband SDR RF spectrum monitoring (400 MHz–6 GHz) omits minimum detectable signal sensitivity and scan rate.
Potential_Impact: Uncertainty regarding intercept probability for low-probability-of-intercept (LPI) hostile emitters.

Issue_Description: Acoustic impulse TDoA bearing localization lacks quantitative angular accuracy tolerance and maximum acoustic range.
Potential_Impact: Risk of inaccurate projectile bearing estimation in turbulent mountain valleys.
Recommended_Clarification: Define allowable bearing angle error (e.g. ±5° azimuth) and operational acoustic range.

Issue_Description: Free-Space Optical (FSO) laser transceiver omits laser wavelength, transmit optical power, and atmospheric extinction limits.
Potential_Impact: Inability to calculate optical link budget or performance boundaries in mountain clouds/fog.

Issue_Description: Automated failover hysteresis and signal degradation thresholds between FSO laser and SDR RF backup are unstated.
Potential_Impact: Risk of rapid channel oscillation (link hunting) or communication dropouts during turbulent bank angles.
Recommended_Clarification: Define link quality metrics (RSSI/packet loss threshold) and timeout duration triggering RF fallback.

Issue_Description: Precision cargo drop pod omits maximum payload mass rating, internal physical volume, and drop accuracy CEP.
Potential_Impact: Cannot perform airframe weight-and-balance analysis or mechanical release stress modeling.

Issue_Description: High-altitude operation specifies -20°C, but omits maximum operational altitude ceiling (m AMSL) and wind speed limits.
Potential_Impact: Aerodynamic flight dynamics and motor thrust curves cannot be bounded in Gazebo simulation.
Recommended_Clarification: Define service ceiling (meters above sea level)

Issue_Description: Low-RCS stealth airframe requirement is stated qualitatively without an objective numerical radar cross-section value.
Potential_Impact: Requirement is subjective and unverifiable against an engineering standard in Tier 10 validation.
Recommended_Clarification: Define target RCS threshold in dBsm / m² across X-band and Ku-band radar frequencies.

Issue_Description: Automated zero-trace flash wiping lacks multi-factor tamper verification criteria and disarm interlocks.
Potential_Impact: Catastrophic risk of false-positive memory erasure destroying flight firmware during high-G hard landings.

Issue_Description: Micro-GPR subsurface anomaly detection omits radar center frequency, bandwidth, and target penetration depth.
Potential_Impact: Inability to assess co-site RF interference or subsurface dielectric imaging effectiveness in permafrost.

Issue_Description: Co-site EMI shielding mandates 'strict RF shielding (EMI gaskets)' without specifying required attenuation in dB.
Potential_Impact: ESC motor switching harmonics may blind the sensitive wideband SDR receiver across 400 MHz to 6 GHz.
Recommended_Clarification: Specify required shielding effectiveness in decibels (dB) across 400 MHz to 6 GHz.
